title: Minimise the Busiest Worker
body:
Assign each of n jobs to one of k workers. A worker's load is the sum of their jobs' times. Jobs need not be contiguous. Print the smallest possible load of the busiest worker.

Function to complete

Complete minMaxLoad(k, jobs). It returns the smallest possible load of the busiest worker.

Input reading and printing are handled for you, like on LeetCode. The input format below is what the tests and Custom input use.
inp: Line 1: n k. Line 2: the n job times.

samples.ex: {4, 4, 4} and {5, 5}. A greedy "give it to the least loaded worker" gives 13.

lc: 1723 Find Minimum Time to Finish All Jobs
ref:
class Solution:
    def minMaxLoad(self, k: int, jobs: List[int]) -> int:
        n = len(jobs); jobs = sorted(jobs, reverse=True)
        best = [sum(jobs)]; load = [0] * k
        def go(i, cur):
            if cur >= best[0]: return
            if i == n: best[0] = cur; return
            seen = set()
            for w in range(k):
                if load[w] in seen: continue
                seen.add(load[w]); load[w] += jobs[i]
                go(i + 1, max(cur, load[w])); load[w] -= jobs[i]
        go(0, 0)
        return best[0]
